Risk Statement: Incomplete privileged-access reviews may allow excessive or stale administrative access to CUI systems.
Planned Remediation: Implement quarterly privileged-access certification with documented owner approvals and exception tracking.

Risk Statement: Incomplete monitoring of remote-access sessions may reduce the ability to detect unauthorized or anomalous access to the CUI enclave.
Planned Remediation: Centralize VPN session logs in Sentinel and implement monthly documented review.

Risk Statement: Inconsistent event-review evidence may allow security-relevant activity to go unreviewed or make monitoring effectiveness difficult to demonstrate.
Planned Remediation: Define review cadence by log source; retain analyst review records and exception tickets.

Risk Statement: Incomplete approved server baselines may result in configuration drift and inconsistent security settings within the enclave.
Planned Remediation: Approve hardened baselines for remaining server classes and validate through configuration reporting.

Risk Statement: Lack of complete application allowlisting may permit unauthorized software execution on engineering endpoints.
Planned Remediation: Deploy and test application-control policy to all enclave engineering endpoints with controlled exception process.

Risk Statement: Inconsistent identifier-handling procedures after separation may create account-governance ambiguity and increase risk of inappropriate identifier reuse.
Planned Remediation: Formalize disablement/reuse standard and retain termination-ticket evidence.

Risk Statement: Without current incident-response testing response roles and escalation paths may fail during a real CUI security incident.
Planned Remediation: Conduct ransomware/CUI-exfiltration tabletop; record participants decisions gaps and corrective actions.

Risk Statement: Incomplete removable-media accountability records may reduce traceability of encrypted media containing or capable of containing CUI.
Planned Remediation: Reconcile media inventory; require checkout/return logging and quarterly inventory review.

Risk Statement: Inconsistent physical-access log retention may impair investigation and evidence of access to controlled areas.
Planned Remediation: Standardize retention and review process across both controlled areas.

Risk Statement: Engineering laptops that miss authenticated vulnerability scans may retain unknown exploitable vulnerabilities.
Planned Remediation: Use agent-based scanning or enforced check-in workflow for intermittently connected systems.

Risk Statement: Absence of a completed annual control assessment may allow control degradation and unresolved deficiencies to persist without formal governance review.
Planned Remediation: Complete annual control assessment; issue report; assign corrective actions and executive approval.

Risk Statement: Inconsistent split-tunneling prevention may enable simultaneous untrusted network paths during remote CUI access.
Planned Remediation: Enforce no-split-tunnel configuration for all CUI remote-access profiles and test enforcement.

Risk Statement: Undocumented advisory triage may cause relevant vulnerability or threat notifications to be missed or inconsistently acted upon.
Planned Remediation: Implement ticketed threat/advisory intake with applicability review disposition owner and closure evidence.

Risk Statement: Monitoring visibility gap on a manufacturing-support segment may delay detection of malicious traffic crossing the enclave boundary.
Planned Remediation: Extend network telemetry to the segment and validate alerts in Sentinel with test traffic.
